functions.name: AddBucket
functions.description: Adds a bucket to the RustFs resource. The bucket is created by issuing a signed `PUT` request to the RustFs S3 API after the server resource becomes ready.
functions.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for the bucket resource.

parameters.name: bucketName
parameters.description: The name of the bucket to create.

functions.name: AddBuckets
functions.description: Adds multiple buckets to the RustFs resource. Each bucket is registered as its own `RustFsBucketResource` child resource and created via the RustFs S3 API once the server resource becomes ready.

parameters.name: bucketNames
parameters.description: The names of the buckets to create.

functions.name: AddRustFs
functions.description: Adds a RustFs container to the application model. The default image is "rustfs/rustfs".

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the resource. This name will be used as the connection string name when referenced in a dependency.

fields.name: AccessKey
fields.description: The parameter used to provide the access key for the RustFs resource. If `null` a random key will be generated.

fields.name: SecretKey
fields.description: The parameter used to provide the secret key for the RustFs resource. If `null` a random key will be generated.

fields.name: Port
fields.description: The host port for the RustFs S3-compatible API endpoint.

fields.name: ConsolePort
fields.description: The host port for the RustFs console endpoint.

functions.name: WithDataBindMount
functions.description: Adds a bind mount for the data folder to a RustFs container resource.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source directory on the host to mount into the container.

functions.name: WithDataVolume
functions.description: Adds a named volume for the data folder to a RustFs container resource.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the volume. Defaults to an auto-generated name based on the application and resource names.

functions.name: WithSigningRegion
functions.description: Sets the AWS signing region used when creating buckets via the S3 API. Defaults to `us-east-1` if not specified.
